trello.name: Implement queue depth alerting for all worker fleets
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Implement alerts on queue depth for the entire worker fleet, not just payment workers. Set warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and page threshold at 5,000 jobs. This should be done in a single configuration pass.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Refactor the retry logic in payment_worker.py (specifically the _process_with_retry function). Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and ensure failed jobs are sent to a dead-letter queue at the back, rather than being re-enqueued at the front of the main queue. Additionally, add tests that simulate processor 503 errors to cover this scenario.

trello.name: Increase DB connection pool size and split worker/API pools
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Address the database connection pool exhaustion issue. Bump the default pool size from 20 to 100 connections. Furthermore, split the connection pools so that workers and the API do not share the same pool. Both changes should be made in the same configuration file.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya. Update the payment incident runbook to replace references to the old Kibana (turned off in March) with new logging links. Document the queue drain procedure improvised by Kofi during the outage. Verify and update escalation phone numbers to ensure they are current and do not route to former employees.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout errors
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate the status page update process. Wire the status provider API to automatically flip the status to 'investigating' with a template message when the checkout error rate alert fires. Initial scope is limited to checkout alerts, with potential extension to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft plan for payment processor failover game day
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of the payment processor failover. The plan must include testing in staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, and include a rollback plan. Note: Do not execute the test until the plan is reviewed by the team in two weeks.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade from 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Schedule the Redis upgrade from the EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. This is a minor migration involving a config rename and changes to persistence defaults. It requires a proper change window via the infra calendar and should not be deployed casually.
